items.q: Dr. Logan. He gave us some shots, you know, for the eyes from working so hard.

ctx.x: Dr. Logan. He gave us some shots, you know, for the eyes from working so hard. He was writing them for ... A couple of days and nights without any sleep.

He was writing for awhile for that concert at Carnegie Hall, and a lot of people thought that he didn't know what he was doing, but Duke Ellington formed his band -- maybe he could not arrange for Jimmy Lunceford's band or this and the other, but he knew how to write for Duke Ellington's boys, because he was writing for the boys, for the instrument.
